sections.title: Use of Proceeds
sections.excerpt:
Use of Proceeds We will contribute the net proceeds of this offering to our Operating Partnership in exchange for OP Units in our Operating Partnership.
Our Operating Partnership intends to use the net proceeds it receives from this offering to repay a portion of the outstanding indebtedness
under our credit facility (the “Credit Facility”) for which it is liable, to fund acquisitions, and for other general corporate
purposes. Certain of the Agents, Forward Purchasers and/or their respective affiliates are or may in the future be lenders and/or agents
under our Credit Facility and therefore may receive a portion of any net proceeds from this offering used for the repayment of borrowings
under our Credit Facility. See “Plan of Distribution — Other Relationships” and “Plan of Distribution —
